scope: Exploratory one-PC synthetic CPU pilot; not a confirmatory preregistration
feature_aggregation: pre-intervention component medians; missing page-input retained null
model_options: Unchanged default support, validation error and quality limits; no posthoc relaxation

analysis.scope: Descriptive paired-block diagnostics; tolerance not a confirmatory success threshold

quiet_execution: All local builds and tests completed before measurements. No local tests/builds/analysis while a measured fixture is active. Observer and experiment controller remain necessary measurement costs.
limits: Background activity of the user's machine is not controlled or assumed absent
No UI input latency or real-app performance claim
No CARP superiority claim without evidence
